name: Power Gem (waves drop)
notes: A drop of the waves mode: the classic run's Power Gem (a red faceted gem), with the same look and the same boost. A wave monster that faints has a 25% chance to drop one of the 5 items, picked at random (item 1 of drop_kind; at most 3 Power Gems per run, see enm_wave_1). It appears at the monster's feet, or, when the monster fainted in the dark edge the player can't walk into, on the nearest spot of lit floor (free_spot). Only the player can pick it up (monsters walk over it): walking into it plays the item chime, floats '+10% POWER' over the player and every move of the player does 10% more damage for the rest of the run, ground zones included (boost_power). It adds to the same variable as the Power Gem level-up card, so the two boosts add up. It stays on the floor until it is picked up or the run ends.
